title: 第九章 木屋温泉第十章 人治
lines: 凉风习习，木屋之中，陆宁慢慢品着此地山茶，味道有些苦涩浓烈，但很提神。
燃了艾草，没有蚊蝇，置身其中，观远方林木山峰，倒是另有一番韵味。
这是甘家后宅的一处靠近绿林的别苑院落。
下首坐着的，有甘氏的母亲甘老太太，甘二郎、甘二郎的妻子焦氏，另外就是甘氏。
甘大郎在东都扬州行商，甘三郎去帮哥哥的忙，都不在甘家村。
甘老太公被大夫切过脉，说是没有大碍，现今服了药，已经沉沉睡去。
看着这位俊美的少年国主，甘老太太虽然有些拘谨，但偶尔偷偷目光瞄过去，却好似看姑爷一样喜爱。
甘氏俏脸一直滚烫，低头不语，由主母变成这位少年郎的小妾，甚或，是地位更低的奴婢，现在又是在母亲及兄嫂面前，实在有些难以自处。
虽然，父母也好，兄嫂也好，都极为趋炎附势，只怕，他们巴不得自己快些成为陆宁这个当今东海国主第下的宠妾呢。
不过，甘氏心里，想想一路来发生的事情，心里又甜甜的。
那刘志才，是断然不敢做出这种事的，那王缪欺压甘家村也不是一天两天了，刘志才却一直巴结那恶贼。
而陆宁呢，第一次来，就将那恶贼打了板子，还要收押进监牢，准备审判他犯下的罪过。
父母也好，兄嫂也好，都以为是陆宁因为喜爱自己，爱屋及乌才会整治王缪。
不过，他，他是这样想的吗？
他，喜爱自己？
甘氏俏脸又一阵滚烫，心下呸了自己一口，想什么呢？
“第下，听刘佐史说，原来，原来王缪的那远方堂兄王吉，输了三十万贯给第下？”甘二郎，到现在还有些不相信。
陆宁笑道：“他太贪心，所以就输了这许多。”
刘汉常的话坐实了，甘二郎心下苦笑，这位国主第下，可真是，真是谁都惹不起的霸王啊！
甘老太太和焦氏，都是倒吸口冷气，三十万贯，这，好像想象不出来是多少财富，普通农家，一年花销，也就一贯钱。
甘氏对钱财并不怎么看重，心思不在这里，但心里却是越来越奇怪，陆宁，为什么一直家里穷困潦倒呢，以前痴痴呆呆的，现在应该是病好了，却变了个人一样，难道这就是书上所说的，天yu降大任，必先苦其心志，劳其体肤？
一名婢女突然匆匆跑进来，进屋跪下急急道：“第下，老夫人，二少爷，二夫人，大小姐，刘佐史传话，已经从王家搜到金阳丹，带了回来。”
甘家人都大喜，但在陆宁面前，自然不好表露出来。
甘老太太只是淡淡道：：“知道了，你下去吧。”
陆宁笑道：“老夫人，你们去看看，那物事对不对，刘汉常糊里糊涂的，莫搞错了！”
“好，好。”甘老太太这才起身，陆宁对她的称呼，她虽然诚惶诚恐推拒了几次，但陆宁一直这样叫，她也没办法。
甘老太太顿了顿，又道：“主君，您尊贵之人，想来每日都会沐浴，这里虽然简陋，但有一个好去处。”
“后山下有一汪泉水，常年是热的，主君若不嫌弃，可去沐浴，老奴已吩咐乡民，不可离村，是以，……”
老太太又顿了顿，“贵儿若去侍奉主君沐浴也无妨。”
莫说去泉水旁，村落都不许乡民们离开，自也没人有千里眼能偷窥。
content_en:
The cool breeze was blowing. In the wooden house, Lu Ning slowly tasted the mountain tea here. The taste was a bit bitter and strong, but it was very refreshing.
When the mugwort is burning, there are no mosquitoes or flies. Being in it and looking at the distant forest and mountain peaks has a different charm.
This is a private courtyard near the green forest at the back of the Gan family.
Sitting at the bottom are Gan's mother, Mrs. Gan, Gan Erlang, Gan Erlang's wife Jiao, and Gan.
Gan Dalang was doing business in Yangzhou, the eastern capital, and Gan Sanlang went to help his brother, but he was not in Ganjia Village.
The doctor cut Old Mrs. Gan's pulse and said he was fine. Now he has taken medicine and has fallen into a deep sleep.
Although Old Mrs. Gan was a little reserved when looking at this handsome young king, she occasionally glanced at him secretly, but she felt as fond of him as if she were her uncle.
Mrs. Gan's pretty face was always hot, she lowered her head and said nothing. She had changed from a mistress to the young man's concubine, or even a slave with a lower status. Now she was in front of her mother, brother and sister-in-law, and it was really hard to handle herself.
Although, parents, brothers and sisters-in-law are all very popular, I am afraid that they wish they could quickly become the concubine of Lu Ning, the current lord of the East China Sea.
However, in Mrs. Gan's heart, thinking about what happened along the way, she felt sweet.
Liu Zhicai definitely did not dare to do such a thing. Wang Miao had been bullying Ganjiacun for more than a day or two, but Liu Zhicai had been fawning over the evil thief.
As for Lu Ning, the first time he came, he beat up the evil thief and sent him to prison to prepare for trial for the crimes he had committed.
Parents, brothers and sisters-in-law all thought that Lu Ning punished Wang Miu because he liked him and loved Wujiwu.
But, he, does he think so?
Does he like himself?
Gan's pretty face felt hot again, and she sighed inwardly. What were she thinking?
"Xixia, I heard from Liu Zuoshi that it turns out that Wang Ji, Wang Mu's distant cousin, lost 300,000 gu to Xia?" Gan Erlang still doesn't believe it.
Lu Ning smiled and said, "He was too greedy, so he lost a lot."
Liu Hanchang's words were confirmed, and Gan Erlang smiled bitterly in his heart. This king of the country is really an overlord that no one can offend!
Old Mrs. Gan and Mrs. Jiao both gasped. Three hundred thousand yuan, this seemed to be an unimaginable amount of wealth. An ordinary farmer's annual expenses were only a small amount of money.
Mr. Gan doesn't attach much importance to money, and his thoughts are not here, but he is getting more and more strange in his heart, Lu Ning, why is the family always in poverty? He used to be stupid, but now he should have recovered from his illness, but he has become a different person. Is this what the book says, if a big task comes from heaven, one must first work hard on one's mind and body?
A maid suddenly ran in in a hurry, knelt down in the room and said hurriedly: "Old lady, second young master, second madam, eldest lady, Liu Zuoshi has sent word that Jin Yang Dan has been found from the Wang family and brought back."
The Gan family was very happy, but naturally it was hard to show it in front of Lu Ning.
Mrs. Gan just said calmly: "I understand, go down."
Lu Ning smiled and said: "Old madam, go and see if that thing is correct. Liu Hanchang is confused, don't make a mistake!"
"Okay, okay." Old Mrs. Gan stood up. Although she frightened and rejected Lu Ning's address to her several times, she couldn't help it as Lu Ning kept calling her that way.
Old Mrs. Gan paused and then said: "Master, as a noble person, I would like to take a bath every day. Although this place is simple, it is a good place to go."
"There is a spring at the foot of the back mountain. It is hot all year round. If the master doesn't mind, you can go and bathe. The old slave has told the villagers not to leave the village. Therefore,..."
The old lady paused again, "It's okay if your son goes to serve the master and take a bath."
Not to mention going to the spring, the villagers are not allowed to leave, and no one has the clairvoyance to peek.
